target: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for optimization dynamics using a loss-landscape and update trace. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

competency.title: Diagnose optimization dynamics — real time
competency.outcome: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for optimization dynamics using a loss-landscape and update trace. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
competency.practice_task: Produce a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair grounded in a loss-landscape and update trace.
competency.setting_constraint: Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
required_evidence: a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair
Include p95 latency, timeout behavior and rollback trace.
Report gradient norms and convergence variability with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: misreading noisy loss as convergence.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of optimization dynamics.
Practice: the repair fixes the target without hiding a regression.
Measurement: report gradient norms and convergence variability against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for misreading noisy loss as convergence; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
